items.title: Earnings beats ease concerns over record U.S. stock rally - WSJ
items.summary: Investing.com -- Strong second-quarter earnings from major U.S. companies have pushed stock indexes to fresh highs and eased concerns that the rally relies too heavily on a small group of artificial intelligence companies, the Wall Street Journal reported.
